messages:
natalie: quick post-all-hands capture  leadership asked for a compact list of why we win/lose + actionable asks. drop 1-line owners/status pls.

sam: TL;DR: we win on latency + easy pilots; we lose on procurement price transparency, private/VPC gaps, and hallucination risk in critical flows.

mira: Sales signal: midmarket stalls when they can't see per-route caps. enterprise stalls on legal timelines for data residency. Owner suggestion: pricing playbook -> Mira.

devin: Eng note: runtime KV cache + microbatching should help p95; prototyping graceful fallback to quantized variant for spikes. Owner: Devin -> perf SLOs + fallback prototype.

alex: CS: top asks = 1) VPC/private timeline 2) token-level export for procurement 3) purchasable SLO tiers 4) reranker/fallback for hallucination. I'll collect top 8 asks and sanitized loss examples. Owner: Alex.

ci-bot: action created: TICKET-5321 "AH followup: wins/losses & asks" assigned: natalie, mira, devin.

natalie: owners, can you add a 1-line customer-facing blurb + ETA to TICKET-5321 by Mon EOD? Leadership needs this for partner updates.

mira: will draft pricing playbook + sample midmarket table. ETA: Tue COB. Will note blockers (finance approval).

devin: will post perf SLO draft + small benchmark appendix. ETA: Wed. Prototype flag for Console token export: `console.flags.token_breakdown=true` (beta).

alex: CS will share top 8 asks + 3 sanitized loss postmortems with example prompts by Fri. Will tag signals: security, latency, hallucination.

sam: small ask  marketing wants 2 sanitized win blurbs where caching + ops runbook sealed the deal. CS/Marketing please coordinate.

natalie: scheduling a 20m owners sync Tue to surface blockers and align messaging. If blockers pop, put them on the ticket so leadership can escalate.

ci-bot: reminder set: owners update TICKET-5321 in 48h.

sam: thanks all  concise and action-oriented. I'll close thread once ticket has 1-line updates. :thumbsup:
